title: J.Jill, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: J.Jill, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 17, 2026, disclosing the retirement of James Guido as Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer effective May 1, 2026. The company designated Mark Webb, currently Executive Vice President and Chief Financial and Operating Officer, to also serve as interim principal accounting officer. The filing states Guido's retirement is not the result of any disagreement with the company.
key_points: James Guido notified J.Jill of intent to retire as Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer on April 14, 2026
Retirement is not due to any disagreement on operations, policies, or practices
Mark Webb designated as interim principal accounting officer effective May 1, 2026
Mark Webb is currently Executive Vice President and Chief Financial and Operating Officer
Filing signed by Kathleen B. Stevens, Senior Vice President, General Counsel, Secretary and ESG
